Variants.Content: Governing western Greece from Arta, Michael II Despot of Epirus maintained fierce anti-Nicaean rivalry for the Byzantine crown. Supported by Albanian highlanders and Frankish mercenaries, the dynasty allied with Manfred of Sicily to contest hegemony across Macedonia.
Epirote archers and mountainous terrain made Arta an impregnable sanctuary against rival imperial armies.
